name: lightrag
notes: In-process use of LightRAG's core library (no server). Default local storage: JsonKV + nano-vectordb + networkx. Insert builds a graph via LLM entity/relation extraction (expensive); retrieval uses aquery_data (only_need_context, no answer generation). LLM via OpenAI-compatible gateway; embedding via the local bge model (custom EmbeddingFunc). Core API is async, wrapped with asyncio.run. Display media removed from upstream source per repo convention. Serves as a graph-RAG baseline.
